title: Korean premium grapes set to enter the Philippine market through exclusive Manila launch

blocks.text: Korean premium grapes are making their way into the Philippine market as the aT Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation hosts the Korean Premium Grape Launching Show on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at Solaire Resort Entertainment City, Parañaque, Metro Manila. The exclusive showcase aims to introduce Filipino consumers and industry stakeholders to premium grapes from Korea, highlighting the fruit’s quality, freshness, taste, and careful cultivation standards. The launch also marks an opportunity to establish stronger connections between Korean grape producers and the Philippine fresh produce market.
